parent_objective: audit tier-aware accepted candidate-set evidence before longer sequence families or optimizer design

public_gates: separate source-level diversity from candidate-level diversity
verify optimizer admission remains blocked unless source-level thresholds pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat 189 candidate rows as independent source diversity
hypothesis: M621 candidate-set artifacts will show useful family diversity but insufficient source-level diversity; the audit should decide whether to run a longer K=7 low-amplitude diagnostic or expand source rows again.
success_criteria: audit summarizes accepted candidate family tier and sequence-length diversity
audit explicitly distinguishes candidate-level and source-level diversity
audit blocks optimizer admission if source-level diversity remains insufficient
audit selects the next no-training branch
failure_criteria: audit treats correlated candidate rows as independent source rows
audit changes target thresholds or trust regions

commands.name: audit
commands.command: Analyze M621 tier-aware accepted candidate artifacts; no training.

decision_rule: M622 passes if it audits M621 candidate-set evidence and chooses the next no-training branch.
